name: hello-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Shared sign-in client; the gateway validates the caller's token and the greetings:read scope before requests reach this service.

description: The Ballerina REST service that returns the 'Hello, World!' greeting to callers holding the User role (greetings:read, enforced by the gateway). It exists as its own deployable because the requirements ask for an API behind the web app. It stores no data and has no other operations.
